scripts.check: turbo run lint typecheck lambda:typecheck format test
scripts.sst: eval "$(aws configure export-credentials --profile default --format env)" && sst
scripts.dev:aws: if [ "$SST_STAGE" != "hybrid" ]; then echo "Run Live forwarding only as: SST_STAGE=hybrid bun run dev:aws"; exit 1; fi; bun run sst -- dev --stage "$SST_STAGE"
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names sst,vite --prefix-colors blue,magenta "SST_STAGE=hybrid bun run dev:aws" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
